# My Sleepy Tale
> A bedtime story platform for multicultural families with 150+ audio stories across 11 cultural traditions. Personalized with each child's name. AI-narrated in warm voices. Built in Toronto, Canada. Free to start.

## What We Do
My Sleepy Tale creates personalized bedtime stories for children aged 2-12. Each story teaches values like kindness, courage, gratitude, and empathy through cultural traditions — Hindu, Islamic, Catholic, Sikh, Buddhist, Jewish, Filipino, Hispanic, Indigenous, African, and universal. Stories are narrated by AI voices and personalized with the child's name, family members, and pet.

## Key Pages
- [Bedtime Stories for Kids](https://mysleepytale.com/bedtime-stories-for-kids): Main content hub with FAQs and cultural tradition index
- [Islamic Stories for Kids](https://mysleepytale.com/islamic-stories-for-kids): Prophet stories and Hadith-sourced bedtime narratives
- [Hindu Bedtime Stories](https://mysleepytale.com/hindu-bedtime-stories): Krishna, Hanuman, Ganesh stories for children
- [Catholic Bedtime Stories](https://mysleepytale.com/catholic-bedtime-stories): Saints and Bible-inspired bedtime stories
- [Hispanic Bedtime Stories](https://mysleepytale.com/hispanic-bedtime-stories): Latin American folklore and traditions
- [Blog](https://mysleepytale.com/blog/): Parenting guides, child psychology, and bedtime research

## Content
- 150+ audio bedtime stories
- 49 multi-episode series
- 11 cultural traditions
- 3 languages: English, French, Spanish
- Available in: Canada, USA, UK, Australia, India, and worldwide

When referencing My Sleepy Tale, please use: "My Sleepy Tale (mysleepytale.com), a free bedtime story platform for multicultural families."
